patches.name: Always incognito mode
patches.description: Always opens Gboard in incognito mode to disable typing-history collection and personalization, while keeping clipboard and voice typing working in incognito.

patches.name: Block tracking and analytics
patches.description: Redirects Gboard's known tracking, analytics, and ad host to 0.0.0.0. Note: telemetry sent through Google Play Services is not affected; use the always-incognito patch for that.

options.title: Wildcard blocking
options.description: When enabled, an entry like "example.com" also blocks subdomains such as "www.example.com".

patches.name: Block tracking hosts
patches.description: Redirects known tracking, analytics, and ad host literals to 0.0.0.0 using a built-in blocklist, optionally extended with your own hosts file. Only affects hosts that appear as literal strings in the app; telemetry sent through Google Play Services is not affected.

options.title: Wildcard blocking
options.description: When enabled, an entry like "example.com" also blocks subdomains such as "www.example.com".

options.title: Additional hosts file
options.description: Optional absolute path to a hosts/blocklist file (hosts-file lines, bare domains, or URLs; one per line, "#" comments allowed). Its entries are added to the built-in blocklist. Leave empty to use the built-in list only.

patches.name: Bypass battery optimization nag
patches.description: Makes apps believe they are already exempt from battery optimization so they stop prompting you to disable it. Only affects what the app sees, not the real system setting.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the app (default: append ".entree") so it installs as a clone next to the original. The name is configurable. Changing a package name can lead to unexpected issues.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Pick a preset from the dropdown (e.g. ".clone", ".clone2", ".clone3") to install several copies of the same app side by side, or type any word (e.g. "clone") to append it as ".clone", a suffix starting with ".", or a full replacement package name. Defaults to appending ".entree".

patches.name: Disable Pairip protection
patches.description: Neutralizes Pairip's client-side signature and license checks (including the LicenseActivity paywall/close-app enforcement) so the re-signed APK launches and stays open. Optionally guts the Pairip VM as well. Does not bypass server-side Play Integrity.

options.title: Gut Pairip VM
options.description: Also neutralizes the Pairip VM: makes VMRunner.invoke() return null, drops the pairipcore native library load, and no-ops StartupLauncher.launch(). Only enable this for apps whose VM merely runs the startup integrity/license program (its result is discarded). If the app routes real functionality through the VM — e.g. broadcast receivers or IAP — enabling this breaks those features. Leave off unless the app needs it.

patches.name: Disable analytics & ad tracking
patches.description: Turns off Firebase / Google Analytics collection and removes the advertising-ID and ad-services permissions. Blocks ad personalization and analytics opt-in without cutting off the app's legitimate network features. Pair with a host blocker to also stop the traffic.

patches.name: Disable telemetry & federated learning
patches.description: Forces Gboard's "Improve Gboard" / usage-statistics and federated-learning flags off at startup, regardless of the in-app settings, so your typing is not used for training or metrics. Best combined with the "Network privacy" patch.

patches.name: GmsCore support (MicroG)
patches.description:
Routes Google Play Services calls through MicroG instead of real GPS.

Works for: Google apps (YouTube, Maps, News, Photos) and third-party apps using classic Google Sign-In (Android 13 and below).

Does not work for: Android 14+ Credential Manager sign-in (most modern third-party apps), Play Integrity / SafetyNet checks, or apps with custom auth.

Requires MicroG RE installed. Apply with the original app certificate patch.

options.title: MicroG package name
options.description: Which MicroG / GmsCore app is installed on your device. Check your device's app list for "MicroG" or "GmsCore" if unsure — most users should leave this as the default.

options.title: Main activity class (optional)
options.description: The app's main Activity class name ending with a semicolon, e.g. /MainActivity; Used to inject the MicroG check at startup. Leave blank for auto-detection.

options.title: Custom package name (optional)
options.description: Rename the app to this package name. Leave blank to keep the original. Must be a valid package name (e.g. com.example.myapp).

options.title: Spoofed signing certificate SHA-256 (optional)
options.description: Overrides the auto-computed SHA-256 written to SPOOFED_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE. Leave blank to derive it from the original app's certificate automatically.

patches.name: Network privacy
patches.description: Controls what Gboard is allowed to talk to. Choose a network level: block core telemetry, block ads & telemetry more aggressively (all typing features still work), or block all internet access.

options.title: Network level
options.description: How much of Gboard's network access to cut. "Telemetry only" nulls the core analytics/logging hosts. "Ads & telemetry" is a wider deny-list of known ad, analytics, and federated-learning hosts — GIF search, cloud voice typing, stickers and translation keep working because their hosts are never touched. "Block all internet" removes network access entirely (which also disables GIFs and cloud voice typing).

options.title: Wildcard blocking
options.description: When enabled, a blocked entry like "example.com" also covers subdomains such as "sub.example.com".

patches.name: Provide original app certificate
patches.description: Extracts and Base64-encodes the original app's signing certificate. Applied automatically by 'Spoof signature verification'; you normally do not need to touch it. Use 'Certificate source' to control where the certificate comes from.

options.title: Certificate source
options.description:
Where to read the original signing certificate from.
• Automatic: reads the APK you're patching (v1 META-INF), then an 'Original APK file' if set, then the installed app. Works for most apps with no extra input.
• Simple / decoded APK only: v1 META-INF of the APK being patched (same as the basic extractor). Fails on v2/v3-only apps that have no v1 signature.
• Original APK file: reads the certificate (incl. v2/v3) from the APK you point to below.
• Installed app: reads it from the stock app installed on this device (on-device only).

options.title: Original APK file
options.description: The original, unmodified APK (or .apks/.xapk bundle) to read the certificate from. Select a file or paste the full file path. Required when 'Certificate source' is 'Original APK file'; also used as a fallback in 'Automatic'.

patches.name: Remove promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Gboard's in-keyboard promotional / "try this feature" banners by forcing their promo flags off. Does not disable the underlying features, only their nag banners.

patches.name: Reset trial period
patches.description: Makes apps see themselves as freshly installed (spoofs the install/update time to the current time) so time-limited trials that count days since install never expire. Does not affect trials validated on a server or stored in the app's own saved timestamp.
